test_item_verbatim: Auxiliary Camera features will follow the general camera activation/deactivation strategies

tcs.tc_title: AUX camera follows the general camera activation and deactivation strategy
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. CAN source: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig (HDCC27, DT27) / STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig (637, 2261, 376)
4. The shift lever is in D
5. The AUX 1 camera view is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 206 (12.875 km/h)
2. Read the HU display and check that the AUX 1 camera view is no longer displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 206 (12.875 km/h) is sent
2. The AUX 1 camera view is no longer displayed and the last known HU display is shown again
tcs.split_reason: AUX camera follows the general camera activation and deactivation strategy
tcs.test_item:
Auxiliary Camera features will follow the general camera activation/deactivation strategies

(AUX camera follows the general camera activation and deactivation strategy)

reasoning: 「一般啟用／停用策略」之逐字內容不在本節，而在 RVC+PAM 本 §7.5 之退出條件族（B01b `-029`／`-030` 所驗）。本列取其中**速度門檻**一支施於 AUX 視角，驗 AUX 是否同受該策略支配。門檻值見 **profile §9**：8 mph ＝ 12.874752 km/h，raw 206 ＝ 12.875 為門檻上方最近之可注入點（**A-CA30**）。
